subject: English Home Language

source.topic: Keeping clean and fit: Emergent Writing
source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'j' and 'm' (tracing in jelly powder, chalk letters on the ground)

show.line: Let's write m and j. m has two humps. j has a hook and a dot.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says m, as in mop.
Trace m with your finger. Down, up and over, up and over.
Tap the letter that says j, as in jump.
Trace j with your finger. Go down and hook. Then add the dot.
Point to m. What sound does it make?

hints: m has two humps. j has a hook and a dot.
Start at the top. Go down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write m for mop.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Down, up and over. Look, I wrote m!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is n. m needs two humps.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Up and over, up and over. Two humps make m!

parent_line: Can recognise the letters m and j, say their sounds and trace them.
